text:
emily: Kickoff for VaultBridge pilot — legal cleared joint mention. Need to align SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and KMS/HSM handshake for BYOK. Goal: end-to-end test in partners-stg and a marketplace listing draft. Who can own cert exchange + attestation?

raj: I can take SSO. Need their IdP metadata + signing cert. Prefer SP-initiated tests first. @tom can you spin up the partners-stg tenant?

tom: Yep, will provision vaultbridge-stg by 2pm PT and seed a few test users.

nina: On SCIM, we need CRUD + bulk import. Please provide a sample user CSV or the SCIM payload. Also want group sync scoped to "teams" only for MVP.

vaultbridge-rep: We’ll upload metadata and a sample SCIM CSV to the Jira ticket in ~30m. We support KMIP and wrapped-key BYOK flow.

sec-bot: Reminder: any test keys must follow the test key rotation policy. See https://redwood.internal/security/test-key-guidelines

emily: For KMS handshake — tom, can you mock KMIP if VaultBridge cannot expose a test HSM? We should still smoke the wrapped-key import.

raj: SAML checklist quick copy:
- entityID
- ACS URL
- NameID format (email)
- x509 signing cert thumbprint
- attribute mapping (email, name)

raj: Example fetch command for metadata:
```bash
curl -s https://partners-stg.redwood.com/saml/metadata > vaultbridge-metadata.xml
```

nina: Proposed minimal SCIM mapping:
```json
{
  "userName": "user.email",
  "name.givenName": "user.firstName",
  "name.familyName": "user.lastName",
  "active": "user.active",
  "groups": "user.roles"
}
```
We’ll treat groups as optional for initial sync.

vaultbridge-rep: Uploading HSM attestation doc + KMIP test endpoint to TICKET-VB-88 now. Also attaching sample wrapped key manifest.

emily: Marketing and legal asked for embargo window: 7 days after final copy sign-off. Marketing needs 2 screenshots, a 3-step how-to, and a short blurb. Can someone produce screenshots once QA passes?

tom: I can capture screenshots after test run. QA: can you run SSO+SCIM smoke tomorrow 9:30am PT?

sec-bot: Security checklist flagged: verify HSM attestation date, KMIP TLS ciphers, and key retention policy before production enablement.

raj: OK running SAML tests tomorrow 9:30am PT in partners-stg. tom please DM me the tenant URL.

emily: Action items:
- tom: provision vaultbridge-stg + attach SCIM CSV (by 2pm PT)
- raj: run SAML tests (tomorrow 9:30am PT)
- nina: run SCIM CRUD tests + bulk import (tomorrow)
- vaultbridge-rep: attach attestation + KMIP info to TICKET-VB-88
- emily: draft marketplace blurb and coordinate embargo with legal/marketing

vaultbridge-rep: Noted. Will update ticket and ping this thread when uploads are complete.

emily: Thanks all — if tests look good we’ll aim for marketplace draft next week, then a joint post after embargo. :rocket:
